name: Big Bank plc
description: Demo: the Internet Banking System example from the C4 model, grown into a bank as it runs in production: payments with fraud checks, notifications, sessions, statements, monitoring and on-call. It uses every designPerspectives feature (tag groups, lenses, characteristic ratings, cost, linked work, owners and links, notes, tradeoffs, usage, sensitive labels, details tables, symbols, pipeline connectors, flows with example data, and code mapped to components). A guided tour is in docs/demo-tour.md. Names, numbers, ratings, costs, links and work items are made-up examples.

containers.name: Payments Service
containers.description: Validates, fraud-checks and submits customer payments, then publishes the outcome. Tells the Held Payment Notifier when a payment is held, released or blocked.

properties.dp.notes:
Split out of the API Application in 2025 so payments can be released on their own schedule.
Every request carries an idempotency key; a retried request returns the first outcome instead of paying twice.
